hero.description: Passionate about web development, backend architecture, and containerized environments. I enjoy building complete applications from the user interface to the server, developing APIs, integrating services, and creating solutions focused on performance, organization, and scalability using a wide range of technologies.

description: Development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications with React Native for administrative systems, including authentication, navigation, and REST API consumption with state management and error handling for data synchronization.
Implementation of intuitive, accessible, and user experience-centered interfaces, as well as native functionalities such as camera access within mobile applications.
Consumption and integration of REST APIs, state management, and error handling for data synchronization and communication with backend services.
Development of reusable logic through custom hooks and modular components to improve maintainability and accelerate the implementation of new features.
Participation in the maintenance of existing code and the implementation of new features within administrative systems.
Collaboration with development teams following agile methodologies and Git workflows for continuous delivery of features.
Development of an end-to-end IoT solution focused on accessibility for people with hearing disabilities, integrating hardware and software for device automation and control.
Design of a modular architecture that facilitated system maintenance and the scalability of new features.
Configuration and administration of Linux services on Raspberry Pi for communication, data processing, and testing environments.
Implementation of device-to-device communication using JavaScript and protocols such as MQTT and Wi-Fi, integrating sensors and actuators for real-time monitoring and control.
Development of the automation interface with JavaScript, including web and mobile views, and addition of a database for action management and device control.
Application of fuzzy logic for adaptive automation and system decision-making.

items.imageAlt: Screenshot of Spotify Insights with Elasticsearch
items.name: Spotify Insights with Elasticsearch
items.description: Big Data analysis using Elasticsearch on a Spotify songs dataset. It enables querying song characteristics such as duration, energy, and valence, while visualizing results through Jupyter Notebooks. The entire environment (Elasticsearch and Kibana) runs inside Docker containers.

items.name: Snakify
items.description: Frontend project developed for an e-commerce platform focused on selling desserts through local stores. It allows user interaction with the interface while remaining open for future backend integration.

items.name: C-Ita
items.description: Mobile application developed in Kotlin, focused on creating a Facebook-style social network for ITA students. It supports user interaction through posts, using both a local SQLite database and an external API built with Node.js connected to MySQL.

items.name: Meet2go
items.description: Cross-platform mobile application built with React Native and Supabase to connect people with similar interests and organize group events. Features user profiles, event management, and a real-time chat system powered by an Express microservice deployed on Heroku.

identity.text: I'm Humberto Emmanuel Rosales Martínez, a Full Stack Developer and ICT Engineer. My interest in technology began with a curiosity about how things work and eventually became a passion for building software that solves real-world problems.

focus.text: Throughout my journey, I have worked on web and mobile applications, REST APIs, process automation, and IoT projects. Beyond any specific technology, I enjoy exploring complete systems, understanding how their components interact, and finding ways to make them more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

values.text: I consider myself a curious and persistent person. I enjoy continuous learning, taking on new challenges, and improving both my technical and personal skills. I believe professional growth comes from discipline, continuous learning, and the willingness to keep building even when solutions are not immediately obvious.
